thread:
kevin: Hey @maria — our rerank endpoint started returning scores as strings and results are being ordered lexicographically. JS SDK v2.3.1 in our app. Repro below.

maria: can you paste the response body + the SDK call you made? also headers if possible.

kevin: response snippet: ```{\"candidates\":[\"red\",\"blue\"],\"scores\":[\"0.9\",\"0.11\"]}``` see how 0.11 is a string, so sorting ends up wrong.

samir: (eng) we deployed 2.3.1 last week — looking. quick Q: are you passing a Float32Array or number[] into the SDK?

kevin: number[] in our code path, but we also call .map(s => s.toFixed(2)) in one helper. i removed that locally and still saw strings from the SDK response.

maria: ok copying that. can you also run a curl against the public API to compare? `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"candidates":["red","blue"],"scores":[0.9,0.11]}'`

kevin: curl returns numbers and sorts correctly. so looks like SDK path.

samir: digging — found suspicious code in js-sdk rerank helper where typed arrays were special-cased. it did `scores = scores.map(String)` in one branch to normalize precision. oops. that will stringify numbers.

ryan: tagging priority: P1-repro. assigning @samir. can we have a quick mitigation server-side?

samir: adding a fix now. PR will remove the `.map(String)` and instead normalize typed arrays with `Array.from(scores)` and keep numeric values. patch: ```diff
- body = JSON.stringify({candidates, scores: scores.map(String)})
+ body = JSON.stringify({candidates, scores: Array.from(scores)})
```

maria: thanks. kevin — would you be willing to test a patched build? i can share a tarball.

kevin: yes please. also note our code calling toFixed earlier may have introduced string scores on our side; but we saw strings even after removing it, so SDK still to blame.

samir: good catch on toFixed — that's customer-level issue if used. but SDK was also stringifying in the typed-array branch. i added unit tests for number[] and Float32Array inputs.

eng-qa-bot: Preflight tests running for PR #4821 — rerank serialization matrix: number[], Float32Array, TypedArray.

samir: I'm cutting a hotfix release 2.3.2 with the change and a quick changelog entry. ETA ~12 hours.

ryan: mitigation: on the server we've added a temporary coercion to parse numeric-looking strings in rerank payloads: we run `scores = scores.map(s => typeof s === 'string' && !Number.isNaN(parseFloat(s)) ? parseFloat(s) : s)` to keep customers online until sdk update propagates.

kevin: installed the patched package (2.3.2-pre) and ran our suite — scores are numbers now and ranking fixed. thanks! :tada:

maria: great — i'll update the ticket and mark resolved once 2.3.2 is published. we'll also add a short note in the SDK migration guide about avoiding toFixed and ensuring numeric types.

kevin: one more ask — can we get a retro on the release notes? we lost ~1 hour in canary because of this.

samir: will add a blameless postmortem note and link to the PR. also adding a lint rule to prevent accidental `.map(String)` on numeric arrays.

eng-qa-bot: Deployment of 2.3.2 scheduled for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC, post-deploy smoke passed.

maria: thanks everyone — closing thread after we ship.

kevin: confirmed fixed in prod after 2.3.2 rollout. cheers.
